answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a peer-attestation pool before it can trade. New identities start with zero reputation: they earn trust only when established agents attest their work, and each attestation is signed and public. A sybil swarm can spawn many raven-dark copies, but each copy must post its own stake, and one detected fraud slashes the whole cluster, sending a ripple through the operator collateral. Reputation accrues like water carving karst: slowly, through verified work, so a thousand fresh identities cost a thousand stakes and yield no shortcut.
